description: This PHP source file provides utility functions related to password management in the SuiteCRM system. It includes functions to check if a password can be sent via email (`canSendPassword`) and to determine if a user's password has expired (`hasPasswordExpired`). The code interacts with email templates, user objects, and system configuration settings.

classes.name: user
classes.description: A user object class used for retrieving and managing user information.

methods.name: canSendPassword
methods.description: Determines if the system is able to send a password email, verifying email template presence and SMTP server settings.

methods.name: hasPasswordExpired
methods.description: Checks if a user's password has expired based on system configuration and user-specific timestamps.
